method: Authenticated Safari native accessibility reads of Olympus Docs modal on Submissions; observations normalized by root. Not a byte-for-byte page export.

sections_observed: Repository requirements and expanded allowed licenses
test.sh and expanded JUnit framework guidance
sources.example_seen: Generic FrostDB example visible while navigating Tips; no pending dogfood case solution exposed.

repository.activity: At least one commit in last 12 months
repository.duplicate_checks: Open, merged, and closed implementing PRs; shipped or deliberately removed capability; maintainer decline in issues/discussions; repo philosophy; platform close matches.

tests.new: Every feature-dependent new test fails at the base commit and passes with the solution.
tests.base: Real affected-area existing regressions must pass before and after; preserve baseline-valid compatibility checks in an explicit reconciled partition.
tests.coverage: Requested behaviors plus obvious edge cases; tests must be described or discoverable.
tests.determinism: No unstable timing, randomness, or ordering; runtime has no network.
tests.errors: Preserve actual failing test identity and assertion output; adapters must not hide upstream errors or misrepresent execution.
tests.error_wording: Do not over-pin exact output unless contract or repository patterns establish it.
tests.harness: Root test.sh accepts --output_path and base|new; emits JUnit; no fail-fast.
tests.exclusions: Flaky, network-dependent, or preexisting-failing tests may be excluded with evidence; valid tests broken by solution may not.

artifacts.description: Natural maintainer-style prose; lead with ask; no requirement bullet lists/headings/code as description or undiscoverable internals unless essential to contract.
artifacts.patches: No challenge/quest/olympus filenames, quest-referencing comments, or Shipd/Olympus/mars leaks.
artifacts.solution: Complete requirements, no regressions, repository conventions, relevant changes only.
artifacts.loc: Effective required production solution LOC only; excludes tests, generated files, comments, blanks, padding. More test LOC does not increase effective solution LOC.

docker.build: Build works without test.patch or solution.patch. Do not run tests; docs also literally say no test commands in a RUN step.

quality_checks.verify_tests: Test patch on clean repo: base passes, new fails.
quality_checks.verify_solution: Solution added: base and new pass.
quality_checks.verify_flakiness: Repeat suites with and without solution; identical runs must have stable test outcomes.
quality_checks.test_quality: Fairness per test, with advisory coverage feedback.
quality_checks.solution_quality: Completeness and code quality against repository.
quality_checks.description_quality: Tone, redundancy, and unnecessary discoverable detail.

rollouts.counts: Current submission panel only; docs explicitly avoid fixed count.
rollouts.quick_check: One cheap agent run; still paid and requires user's specific gate authorization.
rollouts.full_batch: Configurable cohort; one settled batch at a time before edits.
rollouts.fp: Reviews all passing runs; one false positive fails criterion.

auto_review.verdict: Docs say verdict itself does not block submitting.
auto_review.timing: Last after green checks and settled runs; early advisory use becomes stale after changes.
auto_review.staleness: Content edits, check reruns, or changes to agent runs stale Auto Review.

staleness: Results bind exact content; any submission field edit stales prior checks/rollouts/reviews. Dockerfile edits require rebuilt matching image.

unresolved_fields.specific_submission_contract: Not captured by these general docs.

ambiguities: Narrative local-review sequence applies test.patch before Docker build, while Docker requirement explicitly says image must build without either patch. Use patch-free setup and runtime-applied patch verification; retain both requirements in evidence.
Generic approved example uses challenge-named paths/comments despite normative rule forbidding them. Treat example as historical illustration, not exception to current rule.
cargo test --no-run executes no tests but is a test command; prefer cargo build --tests for reusable build-time compilation when equivalent, and verify runtime rematerializes affected components.
scope: Current general documentation evidence only. Does not prove any hosted check passed, authenticate historical artifact bytes, or replace case-specific panel capture.
